svg.text: Pantry R35 — sanitized source excerpt
Position plates and restrain walls (printed page 16)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 16
Execute before the stud installation in Steps 08 and 10. W1 first, then W2; helper for overhead pieces.
printed page 16
HOLD: accepted top, end, slab and temporary restraint details
printed page 16
02. Set the bottom plate on the accepted bearing/separation stack. Align the reference edge to the
surveyed line, then install the specified concrete anchors through the prepared tile clearance holes. Do
not use the wood connector screws as concrete anchors.
03. Transfer the W1 bottom-plate marks overhead with a checked level or laser. A helper holds the top
plate while the accepted nonbearing restraint is installed. Keep the required truss-movement allowance;
ordinary rigid stud angles are not truss clips.
04. Repeat for W2 after W1 is stable.
printed page 16
A7 suggests a truss center about 65⅞ in from the existing finish; W1 plate center is about 65¾ in on the
68-in trial. Locate the real chord before fixing this line. If the actual location differs, revise W2,
aisle and drywall lengths; do not move the wall by guess or screw into ceiling gypsum.
Source family: r35-p16-plates.svg · printed page 16 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
